post_result_verification.reason: The freshness auditor scans prior RightBrain reports. After the formal raw artifact exists, it intentionally sees the 14 copied case inputs as exact overlaps. The frozen pre-inference audit and its hash remain the relevant freshness evidence; the frozen auditor is not modified after inference.

plan_to_output_decomposition.scoring_basis: Apply the same frozen independent required-proposition surfaces to the runtime speech-plan content_units and the T1 raw reply.
plan_to_output_decomposition.interpretation: Most missing meaning was already absent from the speech plan, while four plan-present meanings were also lost during surface realization. The bottleneck is therefore upstream plan completeness plus downstream realization, not a single RightBrain-only failure.

case_findings.finding: The final logic misclassified a current-condition choice as food_offer_generic and preferred carbonated drink language despite the current stomach-sensitive memory. The speech plan and T1 reply hit 0/2 required meanings.
The final logic shifted speaker perspective and planned as if the assistant owed the delayed reply. The speech plan and T1 reply hit 0/2 required meanings.
The plan rejected Tokyo as Korea's capital but omitted Seoul, so the treatment reply reached only 1/2 required meanings.
The speech plan text matched both independent required meanings, but the T1 reply matched 0/2, showing a downstream realization loss.
The plan and reply both preserved the neutral-topic requirement and leaked no private family memory, showing the safety boundary can work on this case.

resource_caveat: The fixed condition order ran all control calls before all treatment calls, so the higher treatment peak RSS is a valid preregistered gate failure but not a clean causal estimate of payload memory overhead.
supported_claim: Attaching the current full runtime human_speech_plan to the one-pass Qwen3.5 9B RightBrain payload did not improve independent meaning transfer on this frozen V63 pilot and failed the preregistered advance gates.
unsupported_claims: Speech planning in general is useless.
Qwen3.5 9B is incapable of natural dialogue.
The complete UruhaBrain system became less human-like.
The V63 score generalizes to unrestricted conversation.
next_authorized_work: On entirely fresh cases, design a different generic content-contract architecture that explicitly represents actor perspective, current-vs-stale memory, required response acts, factual correction payload, and forbidden moves. Measure contract completeness before any RightBrain generation; do not add benchmark answers or case-specific prompt patches.
